Bug_Details:
Arrays.asList does not autobox primitive arrays, as one might expect. Arrays.asList does not autobox primitive arrays, as one might expect. If you
intended to autobox the primitive array, use an asList method from Guava that
does autobox. If you intended to create a singleton list containing the
primitive array, use Collections.singletonList to make your intent clearer.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the line where Arrays.asList(array) is called with a primitive int array. Arrays.asList does not autobox the primitive array into individual Integer objects, but instead treats the entire array as a single element in the list.
Trigger_Explanation: The bug is triggered when the method showBug is called with an int[] array. Inside the method, Arrays.asList(array) is used, which creates a list containing the entire array as a single element instead of autoboxing each primitive value.
